verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents its own proxy support, including authenticated proxies. It also offers an automatic retry over a 'proxy chain', which implies moving across multiple proxies when blocked. However, nothing explicitly documents a rotating pool that cycles IPs across requests. missing for 10: explicit rotating proxy pool / rotation strategy documentation, configuration details for rotation per request, independent or hands-on corroboration of block avoidance via rotation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can route requests through a rotating pool of proxy IPs to avoid blocks

citations.quote: Proxy Support: Seamlessly connect to proxies with authentication for secure access.
Automatic retry with proxy chain and fallback fetch function
